summary: Walter Kent Jackson, 18, of Western Colorado University went missing after driving into Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park at night to camp; his 2018 Chevrolet Tahoe and his body were found October 23 in a remote area east of Montrose inside the park after he drove over a roughly 2,000-foot cliff.
location: Remote area east of Montrose within Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
responding_agency: Montrose County Sheriff's Office, Gunnison Police Department, Montrose County Coroner
notes: Reported missing Oct 19, 2020; cell-phone location led authorities to the area on Oct 22; ~30-35 officials involved in the search and in difficult recovery operations that awaited calmer wind/weather; cause and manner of death under MCSO/coroner investigation; family set up a donation fund for the search and rescue teams; CB News article parent-opened 2026-09-15 (RESOLVES the standing BLCA Oct-2020 Walter Kent Jackson lead). | Run 670 merge: Crested Butte News 2020-11-04 corroboration — body recovered Oct 30, 2020 from the Pulpit Rock area via Hillsboro Aviation helicopter + NPS Mt. Rainier crew; identity confirmed as Walter Kent Jackson, 18, Western Colorado University student (parent-opened).
